property_summary: General rule: whenever a fallback call succeeds at any block timestamp t, a subsequent fallback call at timestamp t+2 must also succeed; the reference (pastBlockTime=t+1) satisfies this for every t, but the mutant stores t+2 so the second call's require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) fails at t+2.
change_summary: Change the assignment to `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 2;` so the stored value differs by one extra second.
